assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The need to detect intermittent arrhythmias is tied to the patient's documented symptoms and underlying coronary and valvular disease
Prior authorization was not obtainable in advance
The service is consistent with SilverBridge's coverage of non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services
